description: This source file implements a Firmware Sanity Checker that verifies the status of the Xconf connection and determines if the firmware image is valid, primarily used in production environments with debug override capabilities. It interacts with platform hardware abstraction layer functions to set image validation status and checks for specific files and responses to perform its logic.

methods.name: doesFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists in the filesystem.

methods.name: isProductionImage
methods.description: Determines if the current firmware image is a production build by reading version info.

methods.name: validXConfResponse
methods.description: Checks the response from the Xconf server to verify firmware filename validity.

methods.name: checkXconfValid
methods.description: Verifies if the Xconf response is valid based on debug override, production status, and response content.

methods.name: TimeSpecToSeconds
methods.description: Converts a timespec structure to total seconds as a double.
